entities.summary: Sanjay Malhotra is an Indian bureaucrat and IAS officer who is serving as the current and 26th Governor of the Reserve Bank of India since 11 December 2024. He is an IAS Officer of the 1990 Batch Rajasthan Cadre, and has served in various positions throughout his career.
